constraints.text: Do not substitute Marwari, generic Rajasthani or standard Hindi for Maidani Mewari; do not invent regional-sounding forms.
Do not default to palaces, camels, sand dunes, weddings or tourist-folk imagery unless the screenplay and approved evidence require them.
Do not infer caste, religion, wealth, occupation, values or universal personality traits from regional identity.

profile.geographic_scope: The plains of the Mewar region; the user must supply an exact locality and the research must remain scoped to it.
limitations: Locality-specific language and visual evidence may be sparse; broader Mewari evidence must remain labelled as such.
User approval is the review gate when a native-language reviewer is unavailable.
Every project still requires grounded research; the profile alone is not permission to invent cultural facts.
research_guidance: Treat broader Mewari evidence as a limitation when it is not specific to the selected locality.
Do not infer caste, religion, class, occupation or values from regional identity.
Separate contemporary practice from inherited or ceremonial practice.

source_policy.locality_specificity_rule: Record when a source covers broader Mewari or Rajasthan rather than the exact selected locality.
